home.title: POS Solutions for Food & Beverage Businesses | Clover
home.issue: home title targets the F&B vertical page, not the brand home; near-duplicates the F&B solution page query

findings.title: The pricing page withholds prices at the moment of maximum anxiety

evidence.observed: One teaser rate ("Pay as little as 2.3% + 10¢ per transaction") and a 6-way business-type self-classification; no device costs, no plan table on the page. Buyer must self-classify before seeing any number.

findings.businessImpact: Comparison shoppers bounce to Square, whose pricing page answers in one screen; the highest-intent visitors hit the least reassuring page.
findings.fix: Surface a representative anchor price per segment on /pricing (e.g. "Full-service dining from $X/mo + hardware from $Y"), keep the router for refinement, and move the phone + "Schedule a call" block above the feature cards.

findings.title: Two visual template generations ship simultaneously on the core purchase path

evidence.ref: home.png vs pos-systems.png/pricing.png (headers, buttons, H1 typography)
evidence.observed: Home: PP Formula Condensed 92px uppercase display, acid-lime/black buttons, 1280-1392px container, mark-only logo. Pricing/pos-systems: Altform sentence-case H1s, #228800 buttons, 1158px container, wordmark logo. Critique heuristic "Consistency & standards" scored 1/4.

findings.businessImpact: A high-stakes buyer doing 10-tab comparison shopping reads the inconsistency as organizational churn exactly where money changes hands; it also splits the design system into two maintenance targets.
findings.fix: Port the new-template header/CTA/footer tokens site-wide as a skin before migrating layouts; sequence full migration by funnel order (pricing and pos-systems first — one click from the hero CTAs).

findings.title: Mobile main-thread blocking is poor: lab TBT 1,124 ms (threshold: 600 ms)

evidence.observed: Mobile (4× CPU throttle): TBT 1,124 ms (poor), CLS 0.212 (needs-improvement), LCP 2.87 s (needs-improvement). Desktop all good. 8 long tasks on mobile load; heavy third-party layer (OneTrust, Adobe Target, Qualtrics, heap, Intercom).

findings.businessImpact: Mobile visitors — the restaurant/retail owners the copy targets — get a sluggish first interaction; INP-class failures correlate directly with bounce and lost sign-ups.
findings.fix: Defer/gate the third-party stack (consent-manager, analytics, survey, chat) until after first interaction; split the hydration bundle; keep hero video but set poster + explicit dimensions to cut CLS.

findings.title: No structured data anywhere: zero JSON-LD on all five audited pages

evidence.observed: No Organization, Product, FAQPage, or BreadcrumbList entities; pricing and pos-systems render FAQ accordions with no FAQPage markup.

findings.businessImpact: Search and answer engines cannot build an entity model of Clover; rich results (FAQ, product, org knowledge panel) are forfeited to competitors.
findings.fix: Ship Organization + WebSite JSON-LD site-wide, Product on device pages, FAQPage on pricing/pos-systems FAQs, BreadcrumbList on solution pages.

findings.title: Home <title> targets the Food & Beverage vertical; Open Graph absent site-wide

evidence.observed: "POS Solutions for Food & Beverage Businesses | Clover" on https://www.clover.com/ — the brand home competes with its own F&B solution page. og:title/description/image/type/url: none rendered on any audited page.

findings.businessImpact: The most-linked page on the domain mis-declares its topic; every social/chat share of any page renders as a bare link with no card.
findings.fix: Set the home title to the brand + category head term ("Clover | POS Systems & Payments for Small Business"); emit the five core OG tags (+ twitter:card) per page from the CMS layer.

findings.title: Public sitemap ships 18 malformed URLs plus test/legacy pages

evidence.observed: 18 <loc> values missing the path slash (e.g. https://www.clover.compos-systems/employees — an invalid host), plus /test-bundle-issue and /pos-systems/employee-management-old in the us/en sitemap; robots.txt declares no Sitemap directive.

findings.businessImpact: Crawl budget burns on 404-class fetches and junk pages; the malformed hosts are dead ends that erode sitemap trust.
findings.fix: Fix the URL-join bug in sitemap generation, drop test/-old pages, add a Sitemap: directive to robots.txt.

findings.title: Heading semantics broken in both directions across the site

evidence.observed: Home renders 2 H1s ("A Clover for every small business" + "Restaurant-grade hardware…"); a testimonial pull-quote is an H2; heading level-skips on all 5 pages (7 distinct skipped pairs: h1→h3, h2→h4, h1→h5, h2→h5).

findings.businessImpact: Screen-reader heading navigation is unreliable (a quote announces as a section); document outline signals to search engines are noisy.
findings.fix: One H1 per page; demote the hardware section heading to H2; mark quotes as <blockquote>; close the h_→h_+2 skips in both template systems.

findings.title: Three unexplained purchase paths compete in one header

evidence.observed: "Pricing", "Shop systems", a cart icon, and "Contact sales" coexist in the header (plus "Get Clover" in the hero) with no signal of which path suits whom; "Pricing" and "Shop systems" lead to different numbers.

findings.businessImpact: Self-serve vs assisted-sales confusion adds a decision cost at every page view; first-timers cannot predict where the money question gets answered.
findings.fix: Collapse to one commercial CTA pair — "Shop" (self-serve, with prices) and "Talk to sales" — and make Pricing a first-class nav peer rather than a utility link.

findings.title: Video-backed sections have no legible fallback state

evidence.ref: home.png, testimonial + hardware sections (~y 6,100-8,300 on the 2880px capture)
evidence.observed: White uppercase display text renders over a gray-to-white ground when the background video has not loaded — the captured fallback state dissolves the quote's third line into white-on-white. Detector: contrast indeterminate over video (media ignored by resolver). Note: the stat-band gray-on-lime pair the detector flagged as washed-out actually computes 7.07:1 and passes AA — aesthetic only, not a failure.

findings.businessImpact: Reduced-motion users, slow connections, and data-saver mobile see exactly this state; the brand's loudest sections become unreadable for them.
findings.fix: Give every video section an opaque dark poster/background-color matched to the video's luminance so text contrast never depends on the stream; verify the reduced-motion state renders the same scrim.

findings.title: Answer-engine surface is thin: no llms.txt, soft-200 unknown routes, 250-word home, slogan headings

evidence.observed: /llms.txt returns the SPA shell as HTTP 200 (soft-404). Home carries 250 words of extractable prose; 18.8% of h2/h3 are question/topic-shaped — the rest are slogans ("Run the numbers", "You bring the flavor…"). No structured data (F-004) compounds this.

findings.businessImpact: AI answer engines summarizing "best POS for restaurants" have little citable Clover text to work with; competitors with FAQ schema and question-shaped headings get quoted instead.
findings.fix: Publish llms.txt; return real 404s on unknown paths; add an extractable what-it-is/who-it's-for/pricing-anchor block to home; reshape section headings on commercial pages toward askable questions (keep slogans as display sublines).

findings.title: Logo variant set is partial and two palette colors are single-context

evidence.observed: No white/knockout wordmark captured for dark grounds; #004422 and #333333 appear as text only (T-color-imbalance ×2).

findings.businessImpact: Dark-ground surfaces (footer, video heroes) improvise logo treatment; the palette carries dead weight.
findings.fix: Produce the knockout wordmark; decide drop-vs-expand for the two single-context colors in the redesign token layer.

findings.title: Footer legal text is set below readability floors

evidence.observed: Footer legal paragraphs at 1.29× line-height and 104-111 characters per line on every page (detector, 3 pages).

findings.businessImpact: The disclosure text that qualifies the $450 offer (3-year contract) is effectively unreadable — a compliance-adjacent trust issue.
findings.fix: Set legal text at ≥1.5 line-height, ≤75ch measure; consider a "key terms" summary line next to promoted offers.

findings.title: Design-token layer is vestigial (one custom property site-wide)

evidence.observed: One CSS custom property across five pages; the visual system lives in compiled CSS-module class hashes (mAZF70It--…).

findings.businessImpact: Every brand decision (like the template migration) is a rebuild instead of a token flip; slows the very consolidation F-002 needs.
findings.fix: Introduce a :root token layer (colors, type, radius, spacing) as part of the template consolidation.

references.title: Square — squareup.com
references.note: Same vertical, one system: a single accent (#006aff) reserved exclusively for CTAs/active states, one type family pair held from hero to footer, and a disciplined radius set — the consistency Clover splits across two template generations. Pricing answers in one screen.

references.title: GlossGenius — glossgenius.com
references.note: Adjacent vertical (salon commerce). Also shadow-free and accent-led like Clover, but with a coherent 13→144px type scale and accent reserved almost exclusively for the one ask — proof the flat/acid-accent strategy works when the scale and CTA discipline hold.

references.title: refero style corpus (fintech/commerce)
references.note: Across best-in-class payment-platform sites, the recurring pattern is one hue + one display register + prices visible within one screen of the pricing URL — Clover has the first, half of the second, and not the third.
